links.name: Lu4
Heal Lv. 1 Restores the target's HP with 50 Power.
Cure Poison Lv. 1 Cures the target of minor poisoning.
Battle Heal Lv. 1 Immediately restores the target's HP with 83 Power.
Group Heal Lv. 1 Restores all party members' HP with 66 Power.
Servitor Recharge Lv. 1 Recovers the servitor's MP with up to 41 Power depending on the servitor's level.
Servitor Heal Lv. 1 Recovers the servitor's HP with 169 Power.
Summon Shadow Lv. 1 Summons a Shadow.
Death Spike Lv. 1 Throws a bone to inflict dark damage on an enemy with 49 Power added to M. Atk.
Corpse Life Drain Lv. 1 Absorbs residual life energy from a corpse to restore the user's HP with 260 Power.
Body To Mind Lv. 1 Sacrifices HP to regenerate 22 MP.
Curse Death Link Lv. 1 Transfers user's pain, using 68 Power to inflict dark damage on an enemy. Power increases as HP decreases.
Tempest Lv. 1 Stirs up a hurricane that inflicts Wind damage near an enemy with 31 Power added to M. Atk.
Wind Strike Lv. 1 Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 12 Power to create a powerful hurricane that inflicts Wind damage on an enemy.
Summon Silhouette Lv. 1 Summons a Silhouette for assistance in combat.
Vampiric Claw Lv. 1 Inflicts dark damage on an enemy with 49 Power added to M. Atk. Absorbs 40% of the damage as HP.
Hurricane Lv. 1 Creates a whirlwind that uses 49 Power to inflict Wind damage to an enemy.
Shadow Flare Lv. 1 Inflicts dark damage on an enemy with 65 Power added to M. Atk. Over-hit is possible.
Demon Wind Lv. 1 Inflicts magic damage. Power: 150. Applies to enemy: Incoming Heal Power -50%. Over-hit is possible.
Wind Vortex Lv. 1 Inflicts magic damage. Power: 126. Applies to enemy: Resistance to Wind -15% Speed -10% Atk. Spd. -10% Cast. Spd. -30% Burns 12 MP every sec. Over-hit is possible.
Aura Flash Lv. 1 Inflicts non-Attribute damage on nearby enemies with 49 Power added to M. Atk. Additionally cancel targets of nearby enemies.
Star Fall Lv. 1 Inflicts magic damage around enemy. Power: 127. Burns 100 HP every second. Over-hit is possible.
Aura Blast Lv. 1 Inflicts magic damage around enemy. Power: 76 in PvP, 106 in PvE. Restores 50 MP to user instantly. Over-hit is possible.
Squall Lv. 1 Directs streams of squall wind at enemies with 48 Power added to M. Atk.
Concentration Lv. 1 Chance to interrupt magic casting -18%.
Mighty Servitor Lv. 1 Increases the servitor's P. Atk. by 10%.
Resist Wind Lv. 1 Resistance to Wind +12% Resistance to Fire, Water and Earth -3%.
Empowering Echo Lv. 1 M. Atk. +15% M. Skills MP Consumption +25%.
Hurricane Armor Lv. 1 Resistance to Wind +12%. When taking 50 or more damage in range 400, 30% chance to enemy: Atk. Spd. -15%. Duration: 10 sec. Reuse time: 5 sec.
Improved Combat Lv. 1 Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects. P. Atk. +6% P. Def. +6%.
Enlightenment Lv. 1 M. Atk. +50% Cast. Spd. +30% M. Crit. Rate +50% Chance to interrupt magic casting -50% M. Skills MP Consumption +30% Speed -30%.
Mass Improved Combat Lv. 1 Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects. For party members: P. Atk. +6% P. Def. +6%.
Mage Attention Lv. 1 Focusing on magical powers increases Skill Range by 30% and M. Def. by 10%, decrease Magic Cancel Rate by 50%. Decreases P. Def. by 15% and Speed by 30%.
Silence Lv. 1 Blocks an enemy's use of magic.
Sleep Lv. 1 Causes an enemy to sleep.
Surrender to Wind Lv. 1 Resistance to Wind -15%. When applied, cancels 'Resist Wind' from the target.
Slow Lv. 1 Decreases an enemy's Speed by 20%.
Poisonous Cloud Lv. 1 Creates a poison cloud around an enemy, causing loss of 24 HP per second.
Curse Poison Lv. 1 Poisons an enemy, causing loss of 11 HP every second.
Curse Fear Lv. 1 Frightens an enemy into fleeing.
Ice Bolt Lv. 1 Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 8 Power to temporarily freeze the surrounding air, inflicting Water damage on an enemy and decreasing their Speed by 20%.
Curse Chaos Lv. 1 Decreases an enemy's Accuracy by 9.
Arcane Chaos Lv. 1 Resistance to debuffs -30% Resistance to buff-canceling attacks -30% P. Skills and Rhythms MP Consumption +10% M. Skills MP Consumption +30% Burns 30 MP every sec.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Arcane Power Lv. 1 M. Atk. +30% M. Skills MP Consumption +10%. Consumes 35 HP per second.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Magic Firework Lv. 1 Magic outside of Hogwarts!
Magician's Movement Lv. 1 Without Robe Armor: Atk. Spd. -20%.
Spellcraft Lv. 1 Without Robe Armor: Cast. Spd. -50%.
Mana Recovery Lv. 1 With Robe Armor: MP Regeneration +20%.
Robe Mastery Lv. 1 With Robe Armor: P. Def. +2 M. Def. +1%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Armor Mastery Lv. 1 P. Def. +6.7.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 1.5 and M. Atk. by 1.9.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
Wizard's Ward Lv. 1 When your Shield Block is triggered, 33% chance: P. Crit. Def. +6%. Duration: 10 sec. Reuse time: 30 sec.
Anti Magic Lv. 1 M. Def. +10.
Quick Recycle Lv. 1 Decreases Reuse Delay for magic by 10%.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Fast HP Recovery Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 1.1.
Boost Mana Lv. 1 Increases Max MP by 30.
Fast Spell Casting Lv. 1 Cast. Spd. +5%.
Fast Mana Recovery Lv. 1 Increases MP Recovery Bonus by 1.1.
Higher Mana Gain Lv. 1 Additionally increases recovery +22 MP when used Recharge skill.
Wisdom Lv. 1 Resistance to Hold +10% Resistance to Sleep +10% Resistance to Mental attacks +10%.
Health Lv. 1 Resistance to Poison +10% Resistance to Bleeding +10%.
Children of Shilen Lv. 1 Cast. Spd. +13 and MP Recovery Bonus by 2%.
Fighter's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: P. Skills Power +5% P. Crit. Rate +5%. With short-range weapon: P. Atk. +5% Atk. Spd. +5%.
Archer's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: Speed +2 Accuracy +3. Only with Bow: P. Atk. +5% Skills Range +5% Attack Range +50.
Magician's Will Lv. 1 M. Atk. +5% Cast. Spd. +5% M. Crit. Rate +5% All skills MP Consumption -5%.
Clear Mind Lv. 1 MP Recovery Bonus is 2.6 while standing and increases to 3.2 when walking.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Spell Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's INT, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
Arcane Roar Lv. 1 M. Atk. +2% Resistance to Fire, Water, Wind and Earth +2%.
PvE Clarity Lv. 1 Single target's M. Skills MP Consumption in PvE only: -30%.

Pestilence Lv. 1 When the skill 'Hurricane' is used, applies to enemy: Incoming Heal Power -5%. Effect stacks up to 5 times, reducing Incoming Heal Power by 5% per stack, up to -25% total. Duration of each stack: 5 sec.
